verdict.rationale: Gumroad is an e-commerce marketplace for creators, not an AI agent or assistant, so acting as an MCP client that consumes other servers' tools does not fit its product type. The only MCP evidence (gumroad-docs-15) describes Gumroad exposing OAuth + MCP so external agents can operate a creator's account. That is the server role and does not transfer to this client-side story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
